title: Impazamo yokuphuma kwimeko
description: Le ngxoxo ifikelela kumda wememori ye-AI, njengebhodi emhlophe egcwalisa. Singayandisa ifestile yememori (ebizwa ngokuba yisayizi yomxholo) ukuze ikhumbule ngakumbi, kodwa inokusebenzisa imemori yekhompyuter yakho. Singakwazi kwakhona ukucutha igalelo, okuthetha ukuba iyakulibala enye imbali yengxoxo ukwenza indawo yemiyalezo emitsha.
lastRequestOverflowed: Isicelo sokugqibela siye saphuphuma kwifestile yentsingiselo.
contextOverflowDetail: Esi sicelo sidinga iithokheni ze-{{request}}, kodwa ifestile yomxholo wemodeli ibamba kuphela i-{{context}}.
emptyReply: Imodeli igqibe ngaphandle kokubuyisela impendulo. Zama ukuhlaziya, okanye ujonge useto lomboneleli.

engine.MODEL_ARCH_NOT_SUPPORTED: Uyilo lwalo mzekelo aluxhaswanga yinjini yangoku. Ukuhlaziya i-injini kwi-Seto kunokongeza inkxaso.
engine.MODEL_LOAD_TIMED_OUT: Imodeli ithathe ixesha elide ukuyilayisha kwaye yamiswa. Imodeli encinci okanye isayizi encinci yomxholo idla ngokunceda.
engine.MISSING_SHARED_LIBRARY: Ithala leencwadi elifunwa yinjini alikho, ngoko ke alinako ukuqalisa.
engine.GPU_DRIVER_TOO_OLD: Umqhubi wakho we-GPU mdala kakhulu kule njini. Ukuhlaziya umqhubi, okanye ukutshintshela kwi-injini ye-CPU kwiiSetingi, kuya kulungisa oku.
engine.OUT_OF_MEMORY: Akukho memori yaneleyo yokuqhuba le modeli. Imodeli encinci okanye isayizi encinci yomxholo idla ngokunceda.
engine.IO_ERROR: Ifayile ayikwazanga kufundeka okanye ibhalwe ngelixa uqalisa imodeli.
engine.INTERNAL_ERROR: Kukho into engalunganga ngaphakathi kwe-Novera ngelixa uqalisa imodeli.
engine.ENGINE_UNREACHABLE: Injini ye-llama.cpp iyasebenza, kodwa i-Novera ayikwazi ukuxhuma kuyo kule khompyutha (127.0.0.1). I-VPN, iproksi okanye isoftware yokhuseleko inokuthintela uqhagamshelo lwasekhaya.
engine.ENGINE_STOPPED: Injini ye-llama.cpp yema ngokungalindelekanga. Ukuthumela umyalezo kwakhona kuyiqala kwakhona; ukuba iyaqhubeka nokumisa, isoftware yokhuseleko okanye umqhubi we-GPU unokuba ngunobangela.
engine.UNSUPPORTED_CPU: Iimodeli zasekuhlaleni azixhaswanga kwiprosesa yale khompyutha. Injini yasekhaya ye-Novera yakhelwe i-Apple Silicon Macs (M1 okanye entsha), ngoko ayinakuqala kwi-Intel Mac. Ilifu kunye nababoneleli besiko basasebenza.

serverPortOccupiedDescription: IPort {{port}} sele isetyenziswa. Nceda zama izibuko elahlukileyo.
